title: Web console hierarchical collapsible tree view
description:
Collapsible Initiative > Epic > Task tree in the Current Status panel, toggled from the flat feed, with default expand/collapse from right_now.default_tree_expanded.

Specs: features/console/current_status_panel.feature (tree scenarios).
right_now_summary: The Current Status panel is gaining a collapsible Initiative, Epic, and Task tree with aligned console behavior.
